About us

About Siddha365

Meet the clinic and learn about the practitioner who leads Siddha365 Health Care Clinic.

The clinic

Traditional knowledge, delivered with care and clarity

Siddha365 Health Care Clinic is guided by Dr. Sindhu V., B.S.M.S., M.D. (Siddha), H.A.H.M., Dip. Cupp, Founder and Chief Siddha Consultant. The clinic offers Siddha consultations in Chennai with a focus on listening, individual assessment, and clear follow-up.

Care is discussed with attention to each person's history and current medicines. Patients are encouraged to ask questions, understand the limits of each option, and seek the right specialist care where needed.

  • Women’s health, fertility, and family care
  • Skin, hair, joint, and lifestyle concerns
  • Traditional therapies discussed as part of an individual plan
